en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from the one who mentioned it, from Aban, from Al A’ala who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Is one of you frustrated that he becomes like the ant, for the ant drags (sustenance) to its hole (anthill)?’.
en.sarwar: 10. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from those whom he has mentioned from Aban from al-‘Ala’ who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
Why should anyone among you be weaker than an ant which pulls (food) to its colony?”’
